donate.title: Support PokéSwarm
donate.body:
PokéSwarm is an unofficial, non-commercial fan game made entirely by one person.
I keep it free and ad-free so that anyone can play.
Your support goes toward the server costs (such as co-op play) and the development of future updates.
If you enjoy the game, a tip on Ko-fi would mean a lot to me.
donate.noAdvantage: Donations never give any in-game advantage, and there is nothing exclusive to donors.

account.signInBody:
Signing in saves your progress on the server so you can continue on other PCs and browsers. It also unlocks friends and co-op play.

Google will say it shares your name, email address and profile picture. This is required by the sign-in system (Firebase) and cannot be turned off.
- Your email address, name and picture are not used in the game and are not stored in your save data.
- Other players cannot see them (friends only see the nickname you choose).
- Your email address is kept as a sign-in record in a place only the administrator can see (Firebase).

You can keep playing as a guest without signing in.

transfer.about: Move your data to another browser or PC with this code, without signing in with Google. No email address or other personal information is used.

transfer.receiveFailed: Could not receive the data. Check your connection and try again.
transfer.confirmNote: The current data in this browser will be replaced by the received data. This cannot be undone.
